title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest accepted by Claude Code at .claude-plugin/plugin.json. The manifest is optional: when omitted the client discovers components from default locations and derives the name from the directory. Authored from the official plugin reference; Anthropic publishes no JSON Schema (the $schema URL the official marketplace itself uses returns 404).
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference. Unrecognized top-level fields are ignored with a warning (--strict turns them into errors), so this schema is open. Paths are relative to the plugin root and must begin with ./ (skills also accepts "."). Claude Code is not listed among agent-plugins.org compatible clients.

$schema.description: Editor autocomplete only; ignored at load. The docs cite https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json.

name.description: Kebab-case unique identifier; namespaces the plugin's components as <plugin>:<component>.

displayName.description: Human-readable UI name; falls back to name and is never used for lookup.

version.description: Semantic version. When both the manifest and a marketplace entry declare a version, the manifest wins without warning.

keywords.description: A wrong type is a load error.

metadata.description: Free-form; Claude Code does not read it.

defaultEnabled.description: Ship the plugin disabled. A marketplace entry value takes precedence.

skills.description: Adds to the default skills/ scan.

hooks.description: Path(s) to a hooks configuration file or inline config. Default hooks/hooks.json.

mcpServers.description: Path(s) to an MCP configuration file or inline config. Default .mcp.json; inline servers are additive.

lspServers.description: Path(s) to an LSP configuration file or inline config. Default .lsp.json.

experimental.description: Newer home for themes and monitors; the top-level spellings still work but warn.

userConfig.description: Options prompted when the plugin is enabled. Referenced as ${user_config.<key>}; exported as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>. Shell-form hooks, monitor commands, and MCP headersHelper reject the substitution.

channels.description: Message-channel declarations; each entry's server must match a key in mcpServers.

settings.description: Default settings. The settings.json file takes priority over this field.

pathList.description: A plugin-relative path or an array of them; each must begin with ./.

configOrPath.description: A plugin-relative path, an array of paths, or inline configuration.
